title: Vietnamese Pancetta Noodle Soup
description: A delicious and comforting Vietnamese-inspired noodle soup made with pancetta, juicy vegetables, and rice noodles. Serve with fresh herbs and lime wedges for a flavorful meal.
instructions: Cook the Vietnamese noodles according to package instructions.
In a large pot, cook the pancetta over medium heat until crispy.
Add the diced juicy tomatoes to the pot and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Stir in the chopped fresh basil and cilantro.
Season with soy sauce and lime juice to taste.
Serve the noodle soup hot, garnished with additional fresh herbs if desired.
